title: Keep unknowns separate from authorized approximation
when: A label, ray, masked proof or source mark cannot be read reliably.
do: Record unknown value and exact source region.
Keep source observation, inference and user-authorized illustration as different claim variants.
avoid: Do not solve the problem to invent a missing source label.
check: No hidden value or answer appears as a recovered source fact.
limitation: Computed O/I in an authored triangle do not recover obscured original geometry.
